effective_date_basis: The date the authorized personnel action was taken, from an agency record or the Civil Service Commission annual report; if no record is held, the end date is unresolved and must be stated as a gap (a not-later-than bound is not an exact first end).
ending_pattern: The order authorizes one action for named persons (appointment, reinstatement, transfer, retention or examination without regard to a civil-service rule). Its operative command is spent when the authorized action is taken. If no use is recorded and the order states no time limit, the end is unresolved and must be stated as a gap (no source-backed lapse date exists). The resulting appointment survives as an accrued effect of the action, not of the order.

exceptions_savings.assessment: The appointment or status conferred is an accrued effect that continues independently of the order (state transferred_or_accrued). Later service rights flow from civil-service statutes, not from the order.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order amends a Civil Service Rule or schedule for a class of positions (type cs_rules_amendment).
The order names a class of persons or positions rather than individuals.
The authority is continuing (for example 'may be appointed at any time').
The waiver is conditional (for example on a noncompetitive examination or probation) or limited to a stated position or period.
The person is named again in a later waiver order (serial orders): read both.
A later general revocation or replacement of the Civil Service Rules and the orders under them: check it as a candidate express end.
The held text is printed in a Civil Service Commission annual report, so the report's commentary or neighbouring orders can bleed into the slice.

A record of the personnel action and its date (CSC annual report, agency register) or an explicit gap.
A bounded later-law search for a revival or amendment naming the order.

scope.note: Membership is a machine lead; each order is decided by an agent, row by row.
